mapper.insert: insert into ledger(ledger_name, create_time) values (#{ledgerName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

insert into user_ledger_relation(user_id,ledger_id,create_time,is_owner,is_default) values (#{userId},#{ledgerId},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM user_ledger_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1) AS t ) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

insert into user_ledger_relation(user_id,ledger_id,create_time,is_owner,is_default) values (#{userId},#{ledgerId},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,0, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM user_ledger_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1) AS t ) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
mapper.select: select ledger_id from user_ledger_relation where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1

select ubr.*,user.username AS ownerName,ledger.ledger_name,ledger.id as ledgerId, user.id as ownerId from user_ledger_relation ubr left join user on user.id = ubr.user_id left join ledger on ledger.id = ubr.ledger_id where ubr.user_id = #{userId}
select is_owner from user_ledger_relation where user_id =#{userId} and ledger_id = #{ledgerId}

SELECT l.id AS ledgerId, l.ledger_name, l.create_time, COUNT(ub.id) AS billCount, -- 无需DISTINCT，因为无笛卡尔积 SUM(CASE WHEN ub.type=1 THEN ub.amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalIncomeAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN ub.type=2 THEN ub.amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalOutcomeAmount FROM ledger l LEFT JOIN user_bill ub ON ub.ledger_id = l.id WHERE l.id =#{ledgerId} GROUP BY l.id, l.ledger_name, l.create_time;
mapper.update: UPDATE user_ledger_relation SET is_default = CASE -- 条件1：指定账本 → 强制设为1（优先级最高） WHEN user_id = #{userId} AND ledger_id = #{ledgerId} THEN 1 -- 条件2：同用户下原默认账本（排除指定账本）→ 设为0 WHEN user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 AND ledger_id != #{ledgerId} THEN 0 -- 其他记录 → 保持原值 ELSE is_default END WHERE user_id = #{userId};
mapper.select: select ulr.user_id as id,user.username from user_ledger_relation ulr left join user on ulr.user_id = user.id where ledger_id = #{ledgerId} and is_owner = 1
select ulr.user_id as id,ulr.ledger_id,user.username from user_ledger_relation ulr left join user on user.id = ulr.user_id where ledger_id = #{ledgerId}
select count(*) from user_ledger_relation where ledger_id = #{ledgerId} and user_id = #{userId}
select user_id from user_ledger_relation where is_owner = 1 and ledger_id = #{ledgerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_ledger_relation ( user_id, ledger_id, create_time, is_owner, is_default ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{ledgerId}, #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{isOwner, jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{isDefault, jdbcType=TINYINT} )
